Drag "Divider" from Design panel to canvas

Drag "Dynamic Text" from Design panel to canvas

Drag "Image & Text Card" from Design panel to canvas

Scroll into view locator('[data-marker="pageBuilderDesignContent"]').locator('[aria-roledescription="draggable"]').and(getByRole('button', { name: /Image\ &\ Text\ Card$/i }))
